claims.claim: Oura API v2 is the only currently supported programmable integration point for Oura data.
claims.evidence: The OpenAPI overview says v2 is the only available integration point and API v1 has been sunset.

claims.claim: Oura deprecated personal access tokens in December 2025 and new integrations must use OAuth 2.0.
claims.evidence: The authentication section explicitly states that personal access tokens were deprecated in December 2025 and are no longer available for use.

claims.claim: A registered Oura OAuth application can connect up to ten users before Oura approval is required.
claims.evidence: The Data Access section states that API applications are limited to 10 users before approval and have no user limit once approved.

claims.claim: Gen3-and-later users without an active Oura membership cannot access the Oura API.
claims.evidence: The membership FAQ says non-members can see only basic app information and cannot access the Oura API.

claims.claim: Oura retains account data after membership cancellation and allows account holders to request an export without an active membership.
claims.evidence: The FAQ says cancelled members do not lose their data and can export all Oura data in CSV through Membership Hub.

claims.claim: The Membership Hub account export is available to all users and can take up to ten days to prepare.
claims.evidence: The export guide marks the route available with or without active membership and gives an up-to-ten-day preparation window.

claims.claim: API v2 exposes Activity, Readiness and Sleep scores and their contributors as explicit daily resources.
claims.evidence: PublicDailyActivity, PublicDailyReadiness and PublicDailySleep schemas each define a score and contributor object.

claims.claim: API v2 exposes daily Stress summaries, Resilience, Cardiovascular Age and VO2 max through dedicated resources.
claims.evidence: The current paths include daily_stress, daily_resilience, daily_cardiovascular_age and vO2_max, with matching public schemas.

claims.claim: The Daytime Stress app graph is more granular than the public API stress resource.
claims.evidence: The support page says the graph updates every 15 minutes and shows four zones, while the OpenAPI daily stress schema contains only day summary and high-stress/high-recovery seconds.

claims.claim: The Cardiovascular Age API resource includes predicted vascular age and pulse-wave velocity.
claims.evidence: PublicDailyCardiovascularAge defines vascular_age and pulse_wave_velocity fields.

claims.claim: Oura's Apple Health integration moves selected normalized records in both directions but does not export Oura scores.
claims.evidence: The official category lists include Oura-to-Health energy, HR, respiratory rate, sleep/stages, steps, routes and workouts, but omit Readiness, Sleep and Activity scores.

claims.claim: Oura's Health Connect integration exports selected activity, body, sleep, heart-rate and HRV records rather than proprietary scores.
claims.evidence: The official export list names activity, body measurement, sleep, heart rate and HRV and does not list Oura scores, Stress, Resilience or Cardiovascular Age.

claims.claim: Oura's Strava route is workout-focused, imports only current-day Strava activities, and does not export automatically detected or manually added Oura activities.
claims.evidence: The Strava support page states the current-day-only import limit and explicitly excludes AAD and manually added activities from export.

claims.claim: The Natural Cycles integration transfers only Oura overnight temperature trend and requires a Natural Cycles subscription.
claims.evidence: The official guide says only temperature trend is shared, no period data or other Oura metrics transfer, and a Natural Cycles subscription is required.

claims.claim: Oura's June 2026 API agreement restricts competing or replicating products, imposes additional aggregator obligations, and reserves future fees.
claims.evidence: The effective 8 June 2026 agreement states these restrictions and says Oura may charge for API or MCP access in the future.

claims.claim: The supported API does not expose raw PPG, accelerometer or raw temperature streams.
claims.evidence: The complete current route catalogue exposes normalized documents and time series but has no raw PPG, accelerometer or raw temperature endpoint.

claims.claim: open_oura is an unsupported local Bluetooth route that reports raw Ring 3/4/5 signals, but it has no detected repository licence.
claims.evidence: The repository documents direct BLE retrieval of raw PPG, IBI, temperature, motion and SpO2; GitHub exposes no licence file or SPDX licence.
